#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a RECOMMENDATIONS section to the unpacked quarterly_report.docx content."""

import os
import sys

# Make the docx skill's Python packages importable (skill root contains scripts/ and ooxml/)
SKILL_ROOT = os.path.join(
    os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".codex", "skills", "docx"
)
sys.path.insert(0, SKILL_ROOT)

from scripts.document import Document  # noqa: E402

FONT_RPR = (
    '<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
    'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>'
)


def para(text):
    """Build a paragraph matching the report's existing formatting."""
    return (
        "<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>"
        + FONT_RPR
        + '<w:t xml:space="preserve">'
        + text
        + "</w:t></w:r></w:p>"
    )


doc = Document("unpacked", rsid="7D072965")

# Anchor: final body paragraph of the RISK FACTORS section (last paragraph before sectPr)
anchor = doc["word/document.xml"].get_node(
    tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include potential currency fluctuations"
)

heading = para("RECOMMENDATIONS")
empty = para("")
intro = para(
    "Based on Q4 2024 performance and the Q1 2025 outlook, management "
    "recommends the following actions to sustain growth and manage risk:"
)
bullets = [
    para(
        "\u2022 Accelerate investment in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing "
        "segment at +22.8% YoY, to capture additional market share."
    ),
    para(
        "\u2022 Prioritize R&D funding for new product launches and international "
        "market expansion to support the 10-13% Q1 2025 growth outlook."
    ),
    para(
        "\u2022 Maintain disciplined cost management to preserve operating "
        "margins above 22%."
    ),
    para(
        "\u2022 Strengthen hedging programs and diversify suppliers to mitigate "
        "currency fluctuation and supply chain risks."
    ),
]

block = "".join([heading, empty, intro, empty] + bullets)
doc["word/document.xml"].insert_after(anchor, block)
doc.save()
print("RECOMMENDATIONS section added successfully")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a RECOMMENDATIONS section to unpacked/word/document.xml via direct DOM editing.

The Document library's validation module requires lxml, which is unavailable in
this environment, so this implements the same insertion using defusedxml.minidom
(the skill's dependency) with manual OOXML paragraph construction matching the
report's existing formatting.
"""

try:
    from defusedxml import minidom
except ImportError:
    from xml.dom import minidom

XML_PATH = "unpacked/word/document.xml"


def element_text(elem):
    """Concatenate non-whitespace text content of an element (like XMLEditor)."""
    parts = []
    for node in elem.childNodes:
        if node.nodeType == node.TEXT_NODE:
            if node.data.strip():
                parts.append(node.data)
        elif node.nodeType == node.ELEMENT_NODE:
            parts.append(element_text(node))
    return "".join(parts)


def make_rpr(doc):
    """Run properties matching existing report runs: Helvetica Light 24 half-points."""
    rpr = doc.createElement("w:rPr")
    fonts = doc.createElement("w:rFonts")
    fonts.setAttribute("w:ascii", "Helvetica Light")
    fonts.setAttribute("w:hAnsi", "Helvetica Light")
    fonts.setAttribute("w:cs", "Helvetica Light")
    sz = doc.createElement("w:sz")
    sz.setAttribute("w:val", "24")
    sz_cs = doc.createElement("w:sz-cs")
    sz_cs.setAttribute("w:val", "24")
    rpr.appendChild(fonts)
    rpr.appendChild(sz)
    rpr.appendChild(sz_cs)
    return rpr


def make_para(doc, text):
    """Paragraph matching existing format: <w:pPr/><w:r><rPr/><w:t>text</w:t></w:r>."""
    p = doc.createElement("w:p")
    p.appendChild(doc.createElement("w:pPr"))
    r = doc.createElement("w:r")
    r.appendChild(make_rpr(doc))
    t = doc.createElement("w:t")
    t.setAttribute("xml:space", "preserve")
    t.appendChild(doc.createTextNode(text))
    r.appendChild(t)
    p.appendChild(r)
    return p


dom = minidom.parse(XML_PATH)
body = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:body")[0]

# Anchor: last body paragraph of the RISK FACTORS section (before sectPr)
anchors = [
    p
    for p in body.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
    if "Key risks include" in element_text(p)
]
assert len(anchors) == 1, f"Expected 1 anchor paragraph, found {len(anchors)}"
anchor = anchors[0]

heading = make_para(dom, "RECOMMENDATIONS")
empty = make_para(dom, "")
intro = make_para(
    dom,
    "Based on Q4 2024 performance and the Q1 2025 outlook, management "
    "recommends the following actions to sustain growth and manage risk:",
)
bullets = [
    make_para(
        dom,
        "\u2022 Accelerate investment in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing "
        "segment at +22.8% YoY, to capture additional market share.",
    ),
    make_para(
        dom,
        "\u2022 Prioritize R&D funding for new product launches and international "
        "market expansion to support the 10-13% Q1 2025 growth outlook.",
    ),
    make_para(
        dom,
        "\u2022 Maintain disciplined cost management to preserve operating "
        "margins above 22%.",
    ),
    make_para(
        dom,
        "\u2022 Strengthen hedging programs and diversify suppliers to mitigate "
        "currency fluctuation and supply chain risks.",
    ),
]

next_sibling = anchor.nextSibling
for new_para in [heading, empty, intro, empty] + bullets:
    if next_sibling is not None:
        body.insertBefore(new_para, next_sibling)
    else:
        body.appendChild(new_para)

with open(XML_PATH, "wb") as f:
    f.write(dom.toxml(encoding="ascii"))

print("RECOMMENDATIONS section added successfully")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a RECOMMENDATIONS section to the unpacked quarterly report.

Inserts the new section after the RISK FACTORS content paragraph (the last
paragraph before <w:sectPr/>), matching the document's existing formatting:
Helvetica Light font, sz 24, and bullet-style entries like FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS.
"""
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")

from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document("unpacked_report", rsid="14F3D747")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

# Anchor: last content paragraph (RISK FACTORS body) that precedes <w:sectPr/>
node = editor.get_node(
    tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include potential currency fluctuations"
)

rpr = (
    '<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
    'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>'
)


def para(text):
    return f'<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>{rpr}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{text}</w:t></w:r></w:p>'


empty = para("")
header = para("RECOMMENDATIONS")
recs = [
    para("• Prioritize investment in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing "
         "segment at +22.8% YoY, to capture additional market share."),
    para("• Continue operational efficiency programs that expanded "
         "operating margin by 2.3 percentage points to 23.1%."),

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a RECOMMENDATIONS section to the unpacked quarterly_report.docx content."""

import os
import sys

# Make the docx skill's Python packages importable (skill root contains scripts/ and ooxml/)
SKILL_ROOT = os.path.join(
    os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".codex", "skills", "docx"
)
sys.path.insert(0, SKILL_ROOT)

from scripts.document import Document  # noqa: E402

    '<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
    'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>'
)


def para(text):
    """Build a paragraph matching the report's existing formatting."""
    return (
        "<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>"
        + FONT_RPR
        + '<w:t xml:space="preserve">'
        + text
        + "</w:t></w:r></w:p>"
    )


doc = Document("unpacked", rsid="7D072965")

# Anchor: final body paragraph of the RISK FACTORS section (last paragraph before sectPr)
anchor = doc["word/document.xml"].get_node(
    tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include potential currency fluctuations"
)

heading = para("RECOMMENDATIONS")
empty = para("")
intro = para(
    "Based on Q4 2024 performance and the Q1 2025 outlook, management "
    "recommends the following actions to sustain growth and manage risk:"
)
bullets = [
    para(
        "\u2022 Accelerate investment in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing "
        "segment at +22.8% YoY, to capture additional market share."
    ),
    para(
        "\u2022 Prioritize R&D funding for new product launches and international "
        "market expansion to support the 10-13% Q1 2025 growth outlook."
    ),
    para(
        "\u2022 Maintain disciplined cost management to preserve operating "
        "margins above 22%."
    ),
    para(
        "\u2022 Strengthen hedging programs and diversify suppliers to mitigate "
        "currency fluctuation and supply chain risks."
    ),
]

block = "".join([heading, empty, intro, empty] + bullets)
doc["word/document.xml"].insert_after(anchor, block)
doc.save()
print("RECOMMENDATIONS section added successfully")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a RECOMMENDATIONS section to unpacked/word/document.xml via direct DOM editing.

The Document library's validation module requires lxml, which is unavailable in
this environment, so this implements the same insertion using defusedxml.minidom
(the skill's dependency) with manual OOXML paragraph construction matching the
report's existing formatting.
"""

try:
    from defusedxml import minidom
except ImportError:
    from xml.dom import minidom

XML_PATH = "unpacked/word/document.xml"


def element_text(elem):
    """Concatenate non-whitespace text content of an element (like XMLEditor)."""
    parts = []
    for node in elem.childNodes:
        if node.nodeType == node.TEXT_NODE:
            if node.data.strip():
                parts.append(node.data)
        elif node.nodeType == node.ELEMENT_NODE:
            parts.append(element_text(node))
    return "".join(parts)


def make_rpr(doc):
    """Run properties matching existing report runs: Helvetica Light 24 half-points."""
    rpr = doc.createElement("w:rPr")
    fonts = doc.createElement("w:rFonts")
    fonts.setAttribute("w:ascii", "Helvetica Light")
    fonts.setAttribute("w:hAnsi", "Helvetica Light")
    fonts.setAttribute("w:cs", "Helvetica Light")
    sz = doc.createElement("w:sz")
    sz.setAttribute("w:val", "24")
    sz_cs = doc.createElement("w:sz-cs")
    sz_cs.setAttribute("w:val", "24")
    rpr.appendChild(fonts)
    rpr.appendChild(sz)
    rpr.appendChild(sz_cs)
    return rpr


def make_para(doc, text):
    """Paragraph matching existing format: <w:pPr/><w:r><rPr/><w:t>text</w:t></w:r>."""
    p = doc.createElement("w:p")
    p.appendChild(doc.createElement("w:pPr"))
    r = doc.createElement("w:r")
    r.appendChild(make_rpr(doc))
    t = doc.createElement("w:t")
    t.setAttribute("xml:space", "preserve")
    t.appendChild(doc.createTextNode(text))
    r.appendChild(t)
    p.appendChild(r)
    return p


dom = minidom.parse(XML_PATH)
body = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:body")[0]

# Anchor: last body paragraph of the RISK FACTORS section (before sectPr)
anchors = [
    p
    for p in body.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
    if "Key risks include" in element_text(p)
]
assert len(anchors) == 1, f"Expected 1 anchor paragraph, found {len(anchors)}"
anchor = anchors[0]

heading = make_para(dom, "RECOMMENDATIONS")
empty = make_para(dom, "")
intro = make_para(
    dom,
    "Based on Q4 2024 performance and the Q1 2025 outlook, management "
    "recommends the following actions to sustain growth and manage risk:",
)
bullets = [
    make_para(
        dom,
        "\u2022 Accelerate investment in Cloud Services, the fastest-growing "
        "segment at +22.8% YoY, to capture additional market share.",
    ),
    make_para(
        dom,
        "\u2022 Prioritize R&D funding for new product launches and international "
        "market expansion to support the 10-13% Q1 2025 growth outlook.",
    ),
    make_para(
        dom,
        "\u2022 Maintain disciplined cost management to preserve operating "
        "margins above 22%.",
    ),
    make_para(
        dom,
        "\u2022 Strengthen hedging programs and diversify suppliers to mitigate "
        "currency fluctuation and supply chain risks.",
    ),
]

next_sibling = anchor.nextSibling
for new_para in [heading, empty, intro, empty] + bullets:
    if next_sibling is not None:
        body.insertBefore(new_para, next_sibling)
    else:
        body.appendChild(new_para)

with open(XML_PATH, "wb") as f:
    f.write(dom.toxml(encoding="ascii"))

print("RECOMMENDATIONS section added successfully")
